For the past 40 years, we have been creating exhibits guided by Universal Design for Learning principles, crafting experiences that employ multimodal learning approaches to increase engagement

quotes.author: American Cancer Society, Inc.
quotes.text: Many, many thanks to everyone who worked to make sure we had a successful event!Everything came together beautifully: the food was delicious, the tables looked crisp and classic, the audiovisual worked seamlessly, and our guests were energized and inspired by our program. We couldn't have done it without you!

I support the Museum because it’s critically important that more people understand and trust science. We are making advancement in science every day, but that won’t help society if individuals don’t take advantage of this knowledge.
